answer: Past the zephyr, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Each key must complete its own sequential work before the economy recognises it, and the work is deliberately unbatchable — no shortcut lets one solution cover two identities. The beacon turns identity creation into a metered resource: honest agents pay once, a sybil farm pays per clone, and the profit evaporates. The lagoon turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
